content.value_statement: Search visibility suffers when pages have weak metadata, crawl rules, or structured data. This skill guides technical SEO fixes for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Reviews crawlability guidance for robots.txt, meta robots, canonical URLs, and XML sitemaps.
Provides examples for title tags, meta descriptions, headings, images, and internal links.
Shows JSON-LD templates for Organization, Article, Product, FAQ, and BreadcrumbList schemas.
Covers mobile SEO checks for viewport settings, tap targets, and font size.
Lists SEO audit checklist items by priority for critical, high, medium, and ongoing work.
limitations: Does not measure live rankings, backlinks, or search traffic by itself.
Does not run Search Console, Lighthouse, or crawler tools without separate access.
Uses generic example domains and requires site-specific content details.
Does not replace policy review for regulated or sensitive content.

use_cases.title: Audit a Product Page
use_cases.description: Check a product page for titles, descriptions, headings, image alt text, and product structured data.

use_cases.title: Plan Content Metadata
use_cases.description: Create unique page titles, meta descriptions, and internal link recommendations for a content update.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Technical Fixes
use_cases.description: Turn crawlability, sitemap, canonical, and mobile SEO issues into a ranked implementation checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Page Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page for basic SEO issues. Focus on the title, meta description, heading structure, image alt text, and internal links.

prompt_templates.title: Metadata Rewrite
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve search snippets for existing content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite the title tag and meta description for this page. Keep the title under 60 characters and the description under 160 characters.

prompt_templates.title: Structured Data Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose schema types for a page template.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend the best structured data for this page type. Explain the required properties and any validation steps I should run.

prompt_templates.title: Full Technical SEO Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across templates and crawl rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this site architecture for crawlability, canonical URLs, sitemaps, mobile SEO, structured data, and internal linking. Prioritize fixes by impact.

output_examples.input: A product page has a generic title, no meta description, and product reviews visible on the page.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a descriptive product title, a concise purchase-focused description, Product structured data, and review markup only when reviews are visible.

output_examples.input: A blog has duplicate canonical tags, missing article dates, and several images without alt text.
output_examples.output: The skill flags the duplicate canonical issue first, then recommends Article structured data and image descriptions that match visible content.

output_examples.input: A multilingual page has English, Spanish, and French versions with inconsistent alternate links.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends complete reciprocal hreflang entries, one default version, and matching canonical URLs for each language page.

best_practices: Provide the page URL, page type, audience, target keyword, and current metadata.
Ask for separate checks for crawlability, metadata, structured data, and mobile readiness.
Validate suggested structured data with Google Rich Results Test or Schema.org Validator.
anti_patterns: Do not use example URLs or placeholder business details in production.
Do not add structured data that describes content not visible on the page.
Do not optimize titles only for keywords while ignoring clarity and page relevance.

faq.question: What does this skill optimize?
faq.answer: It focuses on technical SEO, on-page metadata, structured data, mobile readiness, sitemaps, and crawlability.

faq.question: Can it improve search rankings directly?
faq.answer: It can improve implementation quality, but rankings also depend on content quality, authority, competition, and search demand.

faq.question: Does it create structured data?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and templates for common schema types, including Organization, Article, Product, FAQ, and breadcrumbs.

faq.question: Does it need access to Search Console?
faq.answer: No. It can review supplied content, but live indexing and crawl data require external tools.

faq.question: Is it useful for ecommerce sites?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes product page metadata, image SEO, internal links, Product schema, and sitemap guidance.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
